name: CalanMine
source:
The High Lord of Spring cordially invites you to celebrate the Calanmai at his Court! Enjoy the festivities and spend the night with some of Prythian's most famous faces~

Get to know and flirt with them as you discover the many hidden surprises that await you in CalanMine - an ACOTAR Dating Simulator Game. 

[Edited from [url=https://www.tumblr.com/calanmine]official blog[/url]]
translation:
春天的至高领主诚挚邀请你到他的宫廷庆祝卡兰迈节！享受庆祝活动并与普里蒂安最著名的一些面孔共度夜晚~

在CalanMine（ACOTA约会模拟器游戏）中发现许多隐藏的惊喜等待着你，结识并与他们调情。

[编辑自[url=https://www.tumblr.com/calanmine]官方博客[/url]]
